en.summary: Several pictures can be deleted from the image history at once; prompt enhancement states the reason when it cannot finish.
changes: Install: setup no longer stops when some graphics card details cannot be read; command-line generation works on Windows when FreeVideo is installed in a very deep folder.
Image history: after Select, several pictures can be checked and deleted at once, with a second click to confirm; pictures that are in use or cannot be deleted stay in place with the reason shown.
Prompt enhancement: when enhancement cannot finish and the original prompt is used, the reason is shown; a rewrite that lacks the video or audio description is sent back to the model to add it.

Editor: Extend on a finished video without a description asks for a description first instead of showing an English validation error; when the description box is cleared, the description carried over for that segment is used.
The Linux package now includes curl, so installation and downloads work on systems without it.
Download list: the check no longer hashes every model file again each time it runs; files already hashed are skipped while their size, times and inode are unchanged.
Keeps the failed phase, step count, error type and memory readings of a GPU error that raised the compatibility level, so a diagnostic report sent after a later run still shows where it stopped.
The chat no longer shows the notice for an edited waiting message as an error with a report button; it is a plain status line.

zh.summary: 生图历史可以一次删除多张；提示词增强未能完成时写明原因。
changes: 安装：部分显卡信息读不到时，安装不再中断；Windows 上 FreeVideo 安装在很深的文件夹时，命令行生成可以正常运行。
生图历史：点“选择”后可以勾选多张一次删除，删除前需要再次确认；被占用或无法删除的图片会保留并写明原因。
提示词增强：增强未能完成、改用原提示词时，写明原因；改写结果缺少视频或音频描述时，会请模型补上。
剪辑页：在没有描述的成片后“接着生成”时，会提示先写一句描述，不再显示英文校验错误；描述框被清空时，沿用这一段原有的描述。
Linux 安装包自带 curl，系统未安装 curl 时也能正常安装和下载。
下载清单：检查不再每次重新校验所有模型文件；已经校验过的文件在大小、时间和 inode 都没变时直接跳过。
保留导致兼容档位升高的显卡错误的出错阶段、步数、错误类型和内存读数，之后一次运行发送的诊断报告仍能看出它停在哪里。
对话中修改了正在等待 Agent 的消息后，提示不再按错误显示、不再带“报告问题”按钮，改为普通状态提示。

en.summary: FreeVideo can be installed into deeply nested folders on Windows; many failure messages state the cause and the next step; Windows computers with little free memory can complete generation; consecutive requests run faster on computers with ample memory.
changes: Install: FreeVideo can be installed into deeply nested folders on Windows; when an update cannot be installed and the previous version is restored, the notice follows the interface language.

Launcher: errors state the step that failed and what to do next, and Report a problem includes a line about the environment; when the saved installation folder cannot be opened, Start opens the setup page with the saved paths and an explanation; a graphics driver older than 580 gets a notice with the installed version and the update steps; a damaged launcher settings file is kept as a copy before it is replaced; the launcher keeps working when the prompt model file list is missing, and that row appears once the list is available.

Model downloads: slow sources are retried with a longer time limit, and the last failure reason of each source and route is listed; when a source has problems, the launcher shows a dedicated card with a button to switch sources; the image model has its own download list with links and checksums, exported to a separate folder.

Failure messages: a failed video generation names the stage where it stopped (loading, sampling or decoding); failure feedback starts with the last error; automatic subtitles, subtitle downloads, media import and subtitle import in the editor state the reason when they fail, and GBK-encoded SRT subtitles can be imported; image generation, adding workflows and share export state when the disk is full; an unreadable queued reference image prompts for a different image; a failed part of a long video shows a short status, with details in the error card and the name of any missing file.

Generation: fixed an error when submitting a generation; when first/last frames and references cannot be combined, the failure card says which media to turn off; Generate with AI explains when the media list is full at 32 items; the estimate before generation marks first-time preparation, and a slow estimate gives a reason and a remedy; a queued request shows its wait in minutes or the number of requests ahead; a queued export shows Queued on its button; LoRA files in more naming styles are recognized, and an acceleration LoRA made for the original model gets its own explanation.

Prompt enhancement: scenes with audio, connected nodes or videos can be enhanced, with audio and connected nodes skipped and one frame read from each video; with reference images, a rewrite that leaves out an image reference is sent back to the model once to add it.

Reference images: uploading and reading show Uploading reference image and Reading reference image N%; the + button in the editor shows a spinner while loading; library import shows uploading, queued and processing in turn, and finishes once progress reaches 100%.

Autopilot: it can be stopped while waiting for a reply and shows its current action; after three minutes without a progress update it says generation is still running; a background tab title starts with Confirmation needed, Failed or Done; Edit prompt puts the summary back in the input box; the confirmation card shows the size and duration; when the entry check fails, the entry stays and the check can be retried; an unreadable saved conversation or film leaves the rest available; failure reasons are readable in the English interface.

Multi-shot films: for long videos and multi-shot films made by Autopilot, music is added on request: when requested, one continuous score is laid over the whole film after the shots are joined, and a music file from the user can be used directly.

Create and Your creations: saving or loading a prompt can be retried after a failure; key presses stay inside the creation panel; in the image editor, the History entry stays visible after a picture is placed from the history; the end of the Your creations list shows how many records cannot be read.

Memory and speed: when a Windows computer is refused only because of the default memory reserve, part of the reserve is used, keeping at least 1 GiB, so generation can start with about 5 GiB free; on computers with ample memory, consecutive requests skip reloading the models and run faster.

Mac: encoding with many reference images is much faster; accelerated computation falls back to the standard method when its results look wrong; after a one-click update, a new version that starts slowly is kept.

zh.summary: Windows 上可以安装到层级较深的文件夹；多处失败提示写明原因和下一步操作；可用内存较少的 Windows 电脑可以继续完成生成；内存宽裕的电脑连续生成时速度更快。
changes: 安装：Windows 上可以安装到层级较深的文件夹；更新未能装上并换回旧版时，提示按界面语言显示。
启动器：出错时写明出错的步骤和下一步操作，“报告问题”附带一行环境信息；已保存的安装文件夹无法打开时，点击“启动”会进入安装页，显示已保存的路径和说明；显卡驱动版本低于 580 时，显示当前驱动版本和更新步骤；启动设置文件损坏时，先保留一份副本再保存；提示词模型的文件清单缺失时，启动器照常工作，相应一行在清单可用后显示。
模型下载：下载源较慢时以更长的时限重试，并分别列出每个下载源和线路最近一次失败的原因；下载源出现问题时，启动器显示专门的卡片和切换下载源的按钮；图像模型有单独的下载清单，列出链接和校验值，并导出到单独的文件夹。
失败提示：视频生成失败时写明出错的阶段（载入、采样或解码）；生成失败后的反馈以最后一条错误开头；剪辑页的自动字幕、字幕下载、素材导入和字幕导入失败时写明原因，GBK 编码的 SRT 字幕可以导入；图像生成、补写工作流和分享导出遇到磁盘已满时写明原因；排队中的参考图无法读取时，提示更换图片；长视频的某一段失败时显示简短状态，详细内容在错误卡片中，并写出缺失文件的名称。

生成：修复了部分情况下提交生成时报错的问题；首尾帧与参考素材不能同时使用时，失败卡片说明原因并提示关闭哪一类素材；素材列表已满 32 项时，“AI 生成”说明原因；生成前的时间估计注明“含首次准备”，预计较慢时给出一个原因和一个处理办法；排队时显示“约 N 分钟后开始”或“前面还有 N 个”；导出排队时按钮显示“排队中”；更多命名方式的 LoRA 文件可以正确识别，为原版模型制作的加速 LoRA 会显示专门说明。
提示词增强：场景中有音频、连接节点或视频时也可以增强，音频和连接节点会被跳过，视频读取一帧画面；带参考图时，改写结果遗漏图片引用，会请模型补上一次。
参考图：上传和读取时显示“正在上传参考图”和“正在读取参考图 N%”；剪辑页的“+”按钮在加载时显示转圈；素材库导入依次显示上传中、排队中和处理中，进度到 100% 后直接完成。
AI 全自动：等待回复时可以停止，并显示当前动作；三分钟没有进度更新时，提示仍在生成中；后台标签页的标题前显示“待确认”“失败”或“已完成”；“改描述”会把摘要放回输入框；确认卡片显示尺寸和时长；入口检查失败时保留入口，可以重试；某个已保存的对话或影片无法读取时，其余内容照常可用；英文界面下的失败原因清楚可读。
多镜头作品：AI 全自动制作长视频和多镜头作品时，配乐按需添加：需要配乐时，在各镜头拼接完成后为整片铺一段连贯的配乐，用户提供的音乐文件也可以直接使用。
创作面板与我的作品：提示词保存或读取失败时可以重试；按键操作只作用于创作面板；图像编辑中从历史记录放入画布后，“历史”入口保持可见；“我的作品”列表末尾显示无法读取的记录数量。
内存与速度：Windows 电脑只因默认预留空间不足而无法开始生成时，会使用部分预留空间（至少保留 1 GiB），可用内存约 5 GiB 时也可以开始生成；连续生成多个请求时，内存宽裕的电脑无需重复加载模型，速度更快。
Mac：使用大量参考图时，编码速度明显提升；加速计算的结果异常时，自动改用标准计算；一键更新后，启动较慢的新版本同样会保留。

en.summary: Image generation and editing come to Apple silicon Macs, a Mac update that fails to open is rolled back, and phones on the same network connect more reliably.
changes: Mac: Macs with Apple silicon and at least 16 GB of memory can now generate and edit images.

Mac: in later updates, if the new version stops right after opening, the previous version is put back. The previous version is kept in a hidden folder so it no longer shows up in search or Launchpad. When an update fails, the reason and both buttons now appear right below the description.
Phone access: the phone page connects when phone access is switched on in the launcher, and also works on older phone browsers.

Queue: a single failed read of the queue no longer shows the connection lost card. The card appears after three failures in a row and goes away when the connection returns, and a running loop is kept through a short outage.

Launcher: when the chosen folder is not a ComfyUI folder, the launcher names a ComfyUI folder found nearby. Windows: the engine now starts when its usual port falls inside a range that Windows has reserved.
Installation: an installation with no generation on record now also compiles the standard size in the background.
Failures: when the model file changed during generation, the failure text names what changed.

zh.summary: Apple 芯片的 Mac 可以生成和编辑图片；Mac 更新后打不开时会还原旧版；同一网络下的手机连接更稳定。
changes: Mac：Apple 芯片、内存 16 GB 及以上的 Mac 可以生成和编辑图片。
Mac：以后的更新中，新版刚打开就停止时会自动换回旧版。旧版保存在隐藏文件夹里，不再出现在搜索和启动台中。更新失败时，失败原因和两个按钮紧跟在说明下方显示。
手机访问：在启动器中打开手机访问后，手机页面即可连接，较旧的手机浏览器也能使用。
队列：读取队列只失败一次时不再弹出“连接已断开”卡片；连续失败三次才出现，连接恢复后自动消失；短时间断线时，正在运行的循环会保留。
启动器：所选文件夹不是 ComfyUI 文件夹时，会指出附近找到的 ComfyUI 文件夹。Windows：引擎常用端口落在 Windows 保留的端口段里时，也能正常启动。
安装：没有任何生成记录的安装，后台也会预编译标准尺寸。
失败提示：生成过程中模型文件发生变化时，失败文字会写明变化的内容。

en.summary: Any part of a long video can be generated again as a new video, phones on the same network can follow chats and generations behind an optional password, and the Mac app now updates itself.
changes: Long videos: the part list shows each part's length and what it follows, and marks failed parts. Any finished part can be generated again as a new video that keeps the parts before it, and the original video stays as it was. In the joined video, click a part's length to play two seconds either side of its seam. The list shows only each part's own events, and editing a part keeps the rest of its description unchanged.

Phone access: phones on the same network can open FreeVideo from the phone icon and QR code in the top bar, chat with AI Autopilot and follow generations. Phone access can be switched on or off and protected with a password that phones sign in with.

Mac: an update is downloaded in the background, and Restart & update replaces the app in place and opens the new version. Models and settings are kept, and if any step fails the previous version is restored.
Reference videos: a reference video can now be used without its own sound.
Editor: parts cut off when the engine stopped now show "Interrupted". A problem reported from a failure now includes the step that failed.
Linux: on graphics cards that can hold the whole video model, video generation no longer keeps a copy of the weights in system memory, which saves about 20 GB.
Reporting problems: memory readings in feedback record free physical memory and commit headroom separately.

zh.summary: 长视频的任何一段都可以重新生成为一条新视频；同一网络下的手机可以查看对话和生成进度，可设密码；Mac 版可以自动更新。
changes: 长视频：分段列表显示每段的时长和接在哪一段之后，并标出失败的段。任何已完成的段都可以从这里重新生成一条新视频，前面的段保持不变，原视频也不受影响。整条视频生成后，点某段的时长可播放它接缝前后各 2 秒。列表只显示每段自己的动作，编辑某一段时其余描述保持不变。
手机访问：同一网络下的手机可以通过顶栏的手机图标和二维码打开 FreeVideo，和 AI 全自动对话、查看生成进度。手机访问可以开关，也可以设置密码，手机登录后才能使用。
Mac：新版在后台下载，点“重启并更新”后原位替换应用并打开新版。模型和设置都会保留，任何一步失败都会还原旧版。
参考视频：参考视频可以只用画面、不使用它自己的声音。
剪辑视图：引擎中断而没做完的片段显示“上次中断”。从失败提示提交的问题会写明是哪一步出错。
Linux：显存放得下整个视频模型的显卡，生成视频时不再在系统内存里留一份权重副本，约省 20 GB 内存。
提交问题：反馈里的内存读数分开记录物理可用内存和提交余量。

en.summary: Image generation keeps a history of every picture and needs less memory on both small and large graphics cards, error messages everywhere now come with a button to report the problem, and Windows updates download faster in mainland China.
changes: Image generation: every image generated on this machine is kept in a history, newest first, and can be placed on the canvas, used as a reference, deleted, or opened in its folder. Blank canvases offer Standard and HD sizes.

Image generation: on 6-8 GB graphics cards, decoding uses less graphics memory and runs faster. On cards that can hold the whole model, the weights load straight to the card and no second copy stays in system memory, which cuts memory use after loading from about 15 GB to about 2 GB.

Reporting problems: wherever an error or failure message appears, including generation, editing and export, models and environment, image generation, the agent connection, the library, prompt enhancement, sharing, updates, and the launcher, a Report a problem button next to it opens the feedback form with the context filled in.
AI Autopilot: when a chat cannot be deleted, it now says why and offers Stop and delete; other failures are reported with a button to submit the problem.

White models: only the cat ready-made scene remains, and one click starts it. A white model that was not made now says why and what to do next, and the page shows rendering progress. A question about progress is answered instead of being started as a new request.
Character sheets: in the back view, the head now turns away together with the body.
Mac: long videos can now be generated in parts.

Launcher and updates: Windows updates download faster in mainland China. When GitHub is slow, the launcher can fetch the update from a domestic mirror, and every file from the mirror is checked against the release signature before use. The install confirmation page now fits narrow windows: the sidebar collapses to icons and the buttons stay visible.
Workflows: workflows saved by older versions run again. Options added in later versions that are empty or invalid in an old file are set back to their defaults.

Video generation: the High quality level generates faster. On 8 GB graphics cards, 1920x1088 videos that were refused for falling just short of graphics memory now run. Changing the early steps setting of a video reference now produces a new result instead of reusing the earlier one.
LoRA: a LoRA trained for Wan 2.x now says so when it is selected for the int8 model, instead of only saying it cannot be used.
Linux: on computers with less memory, generating again right after a generation no longer runs out of memory near the end of sampling. On 6 GB graphics cards, Max no longer takes hours to finish.

zh.summary: 生图工具会保存所有生成过的图片，小显存和大显存的显卡生图都更省内存；所有错误提示旁都有“提交问题”按钮；Windows 版在中国大陆更新更快。
changes: 生图：本机生成过的图片都保存在历史记录里，按时间从新到旧排列，可放到画布、用作参考图、删除或打开所在文件夹。空白画布可选“标准 / 高清”尺寸。
生图：6–8 GB 显存的显卡解码时占用的显存更少，速度更快。显存放得下整个模型的显卡，权重直接加载到显卡，不再在内存里留一份副本，加载后内存占用从约 15 GB 降到约 2 GB。
提交问题：生成、剪辑与导出、环境与模型、生图、智能体连接、作品库、提示词优化、分享、更新和启动器里，出现错误或失败提示的地方旁边都有“提交问题”按钮，点击后带上情况打开问题反馈。
AI 全自动：对话删不掉时会说明原因，并提供“停止并删除”；其他失败也会提示，并带“提交问题”按钮。
白模：现成场景只保留“橘猫跳上书架”，点击直接开始。白模没做成时会说明原因和下一步，渲染中页面显示进度。问白模进度时会回答进度，不再当成新要求。
人物设定图：背面图里头和身体一起转向背后。
Mac：支持分段生成长视频。
启动器与更新：Windows 版在中国大陆更新更快。GitHub 慢时，启动器可以从国内镜像下载更新，镜像上的每个文件都先按发布签名校验。“确认安装”页适配窄窗口：侧栏收成图标，按钮始终可见。
工作流：旧版本存的工作流可以直接运行。旧文件里后加的选项为空或不合法时，改回默认值。
视频生成：“精细”档生成更快。8 GB 显存的显卡上，以前因显存差一点而被拒绝的 1920×1088 视频，现在可以生成。改动视频参考的前期步数设置后，会生成新的结果，不再沿用之前的结果。
LoRA：为 Wan 2.x 训练的 LoRA 选进 int8 模型时，会说明这是给 Wan 2.x 训练的 LoRA，不再只说无法使用。
Linux：内存较小的电脑接着再生成一次时，不再在采样快结束时内存不足。6 GB 显存的显卡选“极致”时，不再要等好几个小时。

en.summary: Max is faster, a picture can now be changed only inside a region you select, agents can import their own clips into the timeline, and long videos can take more requests into the queue while they generate.
changes: Quality levels: Max now uses 20 steps with a guarded step cache and finishes sooner; High uses 16 steps with the step cache. The level names stay the same.

Picture editing: when changing a picture, drag a box, click an object, or draw a closed outline to select a region. Shift adds to the selection and Alt removes from it. Only the selected region changes, and everything outside it stays exactly the same. Click selection downloads a 184 MB model from ModelScope the first time it is used.
Studio: while a long or multi-part video is generating, the button stays available as "Add to queue". Up to five requests can wait, and each starts when the current video finishes or is stopped.

Agent: agents can import clips they rendered through HTTP, MCP and the command line, place them on the timeline by frame, and export. Before an agent is connected, the autopilot page says what connecting one is for.
Editing view: a reference picture that cannot be read is flagged right away so another one can be chosen.
Upgrade: when an old FreeVideo tab is replaced, two-pass sampling, first- and second-pass steps, the step cache and the upscale factor are carried over.

Prompt enhancement: after the model folder is copied, an offline package is unpacked, or antivirus software scans the files, FreeVideo no longer asks to download 8.9 GB again when the files are unchanged. It now also works on 6 GB graphics cards, finishing in under a minute instead of timing out.
Chinese interface: browser translation no longer changes FreeVideo's own labels, so the size menu keeps showing MP.
Feedback: feedback sent for a failed generation now includes the engine's error message.
Install: the Windows library checks also handle files in deeply nested folders.

zh.summary: 极致档更快；改图时可以只改选中的区域；Agent 可以把自己渲染的片段导入时间线；长视频生成中可以继续加入队列。
changes: 质量档位：极致档改为 20 步加带检查的步缓存，更快完成；精细档改为 16 步加步缓存。档位名称不变。
改图：改一张图时，可以拖框、点选物体或画闭合曲线来选区；按住 Shift 添加，按住 Alt 减去。只改选区里的内容，选区外完全不变。点选第一次使用时从魔搭下载 184 MB 的模型。
创作面板：长视频或分段视频生成中，按钮保持可用，显示“加入队列”。最多排 5 条，当前视频完成或停止后自动开始下一条。
Agent：Agent 可以通过 HTTP、MCP 和命令行导入自己渲染的片段，按帧放上时间线并导出。未连接时，自动页说明连上之后能做什么。
剪辑视图：参考图读不出来时会当场提示，可以换一张。
升级：替换旧版本的 FreeVideo 标签页时，二次采样、第一遍和第二遍步数、步缓存和放大倍数都会带过来。
提示词增强：复制模型文件夹、解压离线包或被杀毒软件扫描之后，只要文件内容没变，就不再要求重新下载 8.9 GB。6 GB 显卡上现在也能用，一分钟内完成，不再超时。
中文界面：浏览器翻译不再改动 FreeVideo 自己的文字，尺寸菜单保持显示 MP。
反馈：为失败的生成发送反馈时，会附上引擎给出的报错信息。
安装：Windows 上的库文件检查也支持层级很深的文件夹。

en.summary: High is faster than Max again, videos at another size of the same shape can be continued, LoRAs on int8 models apply what they can, Settings adds step-by-step how-tos and an offline tutorial, and the installers are smaller.
changes: High: the step cache is back with added checks, so High runs faster than Max again.
Long videos: parts of a long video and continued parts use 8 + 3 steps, so a second part is no longer refused.
Continue: a video at another size of the same shape now continues from its own ending. Videos that are too short or have too low a frame rate show a clear message.
LoRA: on int8 models, the parts of a LoRA that cannot be applied are skipped and the rest takes effect, instead of the whole LoRA being refused.
Help: "User guide" in Settings shows three how-tos on the real interface, and the new "Tutorial" opens an offline illustrated manual in English and Chinese.
Upgrade: a FreeVideo tab left open from an older version switches to the current workflow and keeps the prompt, size, length, seed, assets and LoRAs.
Agent: assembled videos are saved to "Your creations", and their task cards can be opened.

Install: the Windows and Linux installers are smaller, the prompt enhancement model can also download from ModelScope, and the GPU acceleration step shows one steady name and description while it builds.

zh.summary: 精细档重新比极致档快；同比例、不同尺寸的视频可以接着生成；int8 模型上的 LoRA 能用的部分照常生效；设置中新增分步演示和离线教程；安装包变小。
changes: 精细档：重新启用步缓存，并加上检查，精细档重新比极致档快。
长视频：长视频的分段和接着生成的分段统一使用 8 + 3 步，第二段不再被拒绝。
接着生成：同比例、不同尺寸的视频改为从它自己的结尾接着生成；太短或帧率太低的视频会给出明确提示。
LoRA：在 int8 模型上，LoRA 中无法应用的部分会跳过，其余照常生效，不再整个拒绝。
帮助：设置中的“使用说明”改为在真实界面上演示三项操作；新增“教程”，可打开中英文离线图文手册。
升级：旧版本留在标签页中的 FreeVideo 工作流会换成当前版本，并保留提示词、尺寸、时长、种子、素材和 LoRA。
Agent：拼接的成片保存到“我的作品”，任务卡可以打开。
安装：Windows 和 Linux 安装包变小；提示词增强模型也可以从魔搭下载；GPU 加速组件构建时，名称和说明保持不变。

en.summary: Preview white-model scenes for Autopilot, LoRA compatibility checks and drag-to-reorder, clearer failure messages, deleting edits, a faster start for a busy machine, and a Medium level that samples two passes.
changes: Autopilot: an optional white-model preview, with ready-made scenes, shows the scene before the video is made; the entry showcase has an example.
LoRA: a compatibility check before generating, and LoRAs can be reordered by dragging.
Failure messages: submission, queue and browser-extension failures share one layout and say what to do next; failed requests can be packaged with Export report or Submit to GitHub.
Editor: an edit can be deleted, an empty untouched edit is discarded, and reopening an edit restores its cover and shows its finishing stage; continuations are queued on the server.
Characters: each character carries a sheet of all views plus a face close-up; a picture that cannot be read is refused with a message on its own tile.
Medium: samples two passes from a larger first pass; Max runs all 20 steps without a cache.
Install: the GPU acceleration build has a visible share of the progress, the model line stays steady while groups download, and torch shows as Runtime components.
Downloads: before a download starts, the launcher, the page and the editor say what it is and how long it takes.

Guide: the first-run guide shows where to add reference images and first or last frames, the length field shows the part limit, and the Chinese interface links a user guide beside the guide in Settings.
Reusing reference pictures and clips when only the prompt changes skips encoding them again; on a busy machine the small CPU table work of loading runs on one thread.
Mac: a device that cannot continue a video refuses lengths over one block up front.
The feedback button opens the issue form.

zh.summary: AI 全自动新增白模预览场景，LoRA 兼容性检查和拖动排序，失败提示更清楚，可以删除剪辑，繁忙的机器上启动更快，标准档改为两遍采样。
changes: AI 全自动：可选的白模预览和现成场景，在生成视频前先看到场景；入口展示里有示例。
LoRA：生成前做兼容性检查，LoRA 可以拖动排序。
失败提示：提交、排队和浏览器扩展的失败用同一种版式，并说明下一步该做什么；失败的请求可以打包为导出报告或提交到 GitHub。
编辑器：可以删除剪辑，没改动的空剪辑自动丢弃；重新打开剪辑会恢复封面并显示收尾阶段；续接在服务端排队。
角色：每个角色带有全部视角的角色图和脸部特写；读不出来的图片会被拒绝，并在对应的格子上给出提示。
标准档：从更大的第一遍起采样两遍；极致档跑满 20 步且不使用缓存。
安装：GPU 加速组件的构建在进度中占有可见的份额，模型下载分组并行时进度行保持稳定，torch 显示为“运行组件”。
下载：开始下载前，启动器、页面和编辑器会说明这是什么下载、需要多久。
指引：首次指引新增一步，说明在哪里添加参考图和首帧、尾帧；时长栏直接显示分段上限；中文界面在设置里可以打开使用说明。
只改提示词时，参考图和片段不再重复编码；机器繁忙时，加载过程中的小型 CPU 表运算改为单线程。
Mac：不能续接视频的设备会在一开始就拒绝超过一个分段的长度。
反馈按钮直接打开问题表单。

en.summary: Fixes requests being rejected with a frame count error, and LoRAs with extra parts generating on the int8 build.
changes: Generating from a workflow or a restored tab where Total frames holds a number that is not a frame count is no longer rejected with a frame count error; the number is read as the duration.
int8: a LoRA that also contains modulation parts no longer stops the generation; those parts are skipped one by one and the number skipped appears in the report.

zh.summary: 修复请求被帧数错误拒绝的问题，并让带额外部分的 LoRA 能在 int8 版本上正常生成。
changes: 用 Total frames 里填的不是帧数的工作流或恢复的标签页生成时，不再被帧数错误拒绝，这个数会按时长读取。
int8：带调制部分的 LoRA 不再让生成中断，这些部分会逐个跳过，跳过的数量写进报告。

en.summary: High on Mac uses the step cache and finishes much sooner; in the editor, audio clips can move to another audio track, and several notices and narrow-window layouts are clearer; workflows saved by an earlier version generate again.
changes: Mac: High uses the step cache on the first pass and finishes much sooner, and the starting time estimate is based on the chip, so it is closer from the first step.
Editor: an audio clip dragged from the library onto the second audio track lands there, and a single audio clip on the timeline can be dragged to another audio track.
Editor: pressing split or trim while the playhead is outside the selected part, or asking for full screen where the browser refuses it, now says why in one line.
Character mentions written back to back, with no space between the names, are each recognised, and the character list opens again right after a name.
Autopilot: while a task is running, the Autopilot button in the header stays whole and clickable in narrow windows.
Chat: on phones and other narrow windows, button names quoted in notices stay on one line.

Diagnostic reports for failed image and video requests record the available memory when the request started and when the generation process ended, and whether the system appears to have ended the process.
Nodes: the English Width, Height and Seed labels are capitalised like the other fields.
Generating from a workflow saved by an earlier version, or from a restored tab, no longer fails with an invalid step cache setting.

zh.summary: Mac 精细档使用步间缓存，快得多；编辑器里音频片段可以拖到另一条音频轨；几处提示和窄窗口布局更清楚；旧版本保存的工作流又能正常生成。
changes: Mac：精细档第一遍使用步间缓存，快得多；开始时的预计时间按芯片给出，从第一步起就更接近实际。
编辑器：从素材库把音频拖到第二条音频轨会放在该轨；时间线上单个音频片段可以拖到另一条音频轨。
编辑器：播放头不在所选片段上时按切分或修剪，或在浏览器不允许全屏的地方点全屏，会用一行字说明原因。
连着写、名字之间没有空格的角色提及都能被识别，写完一个名字后接着输入也会弹出角色列表。
AI 全自动：有任务在跑时，窄窗口里顶栏的“AI 全自动”按钮也始终完整可点。
对话：手机等窄窗口里，提示中引号内的按钮名不再被拆到两行。
图像和视频失败请求的诊断报告现在记录请求开始和生成进程结束时的可用内存，并标明进程是否疑似被系统结束。
节点：英文界面里 Width、Height、Seed 的大小写与其他项一致。
修复：用旧版本保存的工作流或恢复的标签页生成时提示步间缓存参数无效。
